summary: Validate complete MP4 movie/media time-header payload sizes
before: Both MP4 wrappers accepted all 12 owned mvhd/mdhd v0/v1 companions with a shortened or extended fixed payload. Valid-header packet/clock/budget controls passed; original core result 1 passed, 1 failed.
after: Validate the complete version-specific fixed payload before reading timestamps: mvhd 100/112 bytes, mdhd 24/36 bytes. Core 9, player 20 and related integration 37 tests pass, no failures or ignored tests. Valid V0/V1 videos preserve exact RGB, 60ms duration, packet clocks, seek, rewind and repeated EOF. The old basic MP4 test constructor now authors a complete movie header; all original assertions remain.
